paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.98% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+3.13%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-6.07%). Brent crude changed +1.06% to 107.78. Gold changed +0.30% to 4,203.2998. Bitcoin changed -0.73% to 82,490.0312. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.098%, a relative move of -2.78%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+9.25%) and Equinor (+9.23%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Private equity finds next Asian frontier (FT World). Foreign firms make up majority of large buyout deals in Asia’s fourth-biggest economy Deals and capital markets: Private equity group Charlesbank closes one of the biggest law firm deals (FT Companies). Stake in Wood Smith Henning & Berman could herald wave of investments in US liability defence firms Central banks and macro: US inflation jumps to 3.7% as Iran war drives up prices (FT World). Rebound in fuel costs has piled pressure on voters ahead of midterm elections Central banks and macro: Trump has failed to listen to voters on inflation (FT World). People elect presidents to fix problems, not to diagnose their causes Geopolitics and trade: How will Big Oil spend its $32bn Iran war windfall? (FT Markets). Investors are keen to see how the world’s largest crude companies plan to deploy extra cash generated by soaring energy prices
